attributes.residual: NOTHING RETAINED; baseline restored at real 370, T568/O568, opcode multiset IDENTICAL, frame 136 both, saves r28 both, SLOT MAP IDENTICAL. TWO NAMED MECHANISMS, both now bounded. (A) SCHEDULE WINDOW, 0x134-0x168, six clusters. The source is `f32 rate = gCurLevel->ene_speed * (f32)(u32)gFrameTicks;` and the residual is purely WHEN the `lfs 176(rN)` field read is issued: target loads the gCurLevel pointer at 0x144 but defers the field read to 0x164, immediately before the fmuls, reusing the FPR that held the int-to-double magic constant (`lfd` from the SDA f64) once `fsubs` has consumed it; ours issues the field read at 0x144 into a second FPR. AXIS DEAD by the two-identical-A/Bs rule in its strongest form: both probes returned a cluster list BYTE-IDENTICAL to baseline - same six offsets 0x134/0x138/0x144/0x154/0x160/0x164, same opcodes on each side - so neither statement decomposition nor operand order reaches this scheduler decision, and each merely cost rows elsewhere. Note also a pool-symbol difference in this window that is NOT source-reachable: target's f64 magic constant is the named `lbl_803468D0` via EMB_SDA21 while ours is a compiler-generated pool entry `@712` via the same reloc kind - the constant is emitted by the (u32)->f32 conversion, not written in source. (B) CALLEE-SAVED GROUP SWAP: target colours the Enemy* walker AND the gTextFormatBuf address home r30 and `shown` r29; ours has them exactly swapped, and the same swap appears in the FP file (f26<->f30, f27<->f31). This accounts for the bulk of real 370 - regnorm reports 178 RENAMING rows. Axis 3 aimed at it with the one law that governs it and measured BYTE-IDENTICAL: MWCC folds a first-statement `shown = 0;` back into the declaration, so the local never leaves the initialized group and the lever cannot be pulled from source. WEBFRANK CANDIDACY, checked as the lane asked: the recolor half (B) is textbook copy_register_fields material - equal counts, IDENTICAL multiset, IDENTICAL slot map - but the function is NOT eligible while (A) stands, because regnorm reports 5 STRUCTURAL and 10 unpaired rows, all inside the 0x134-0x168 window, and a recolor rule cannot reorder instructions. CLOSING (A) BY SOURCE WOULD MAKE THIS FUNCTION A PURE RENAMING BISIMULATION AND HENCE A STRONG PIN CANDIDATE; that, not more register work, is the correct next move on do_enemies.
